mapper.select: SELECT w.wishlist_id, w.member_id, w.product_id, gb.group_buy_id, w.created_at, p.sale_type, p.brand, p.product_name, p.price_jpy, p.original_price_jpy, p.thumbnail_url, p.stock, p.status AS product_status, CASE WHEN gb.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN gb.status WHEN gb.current_quantity >= gb.target_quantity THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN gb.end_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'FAILED' WHEN gb.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN 'CLOSING_SOON' ELSE gb.status END AS group_buy_status FROM WISHLIST w JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = w.product_id LEFT JOIN GROUP_BUY gb ON gb.group_buy_id = ( SELECT gb2.group_buy_id FROM GROUP_BUY gb2 WHERE gb2.product_id = w.product_id ORDER BY gb2.group_buy_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.wishlist_id DESC
